paragraphs: The Nasdaq enters the early outlook with a cautiously negative setup: the Nasdaq Score is -40/100. Consolidation Risk is 2/100 (Low).
The main cross-asset drivers are Rates are a headwind: the 10Y is 4.954%. Volatility is a headwind: VXN 28.50 (+13.19%) | VIX 19.42 (+12.91%). Fed pricing remains a headwind.
Nasdaq internals provide constructive confirmation (semiconductors negative, mega-caps positive, breadth positive).

What would change the view: improvement would require Treasury yields easing and stabilizing, semiconductors regaining leadership, VXN/VIX cooling. Deterioration would be reinforced by breadth narrowing materially.
